question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart shows the amount of money (in ₹) spent (in degrees) on various sports by a school administration in a particular year. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98b7f0dff67cbd7745947c148811b9da2d7436ce1ae4263c4baf2378588380dd.png] 

If Rs. 21,000 was spent on Football, then the money spent on Tennis and Basketball taken together is what percentage (rounded off to 2 decimal places) of money spent on Hockey and Cricket taken together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Money spent on Tennis and Basketball = 35∘ + 40∘ = 75∘

Money spent on Hockey and Cricket = 94∘ + 135∘ = 229∘

Percentage = (75/229) × 100 = 32.75%

∴ The percentage is approximately 32.75%.

**Given:**

Money spent on Football = ₹21,000

Angles in pie chart:

Hockey = 94°

Cricket = 135°

Basketball = 40°

Tennis = 35°

Football = 42°

Badminton = 14°

**Formula used:**

Total degrees in pie chart = 360°

Amount per degree = Total amount / Total degrees

Percentage calculation

**Calculation:**

Amount per degree = 21000 / 42

⇒ Amount per degree = 500

Money spent on Tennis = 35 × 500

⇒ Money spent on Tennis = ₹17,500

Money spent on Basketball = 40 × 500

⇒ Money spent on Basketball = ₹20,000

Total money spent on Tennis and Basketball = ₹17,500 + ₹20,000

⇒ Total = ₹37,500

Total money spent on Hockey and Cricket:

Hockey = 94° × 500 = ₹47,000

Cricket = 135° × 500 = ₹67,500

Total = ₹47,000 + ₹67,500

⇒ Total = ₹114,500

Percentage = (37,500 / 114,500) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 32.75 %

**∴ The percentage is approximately 32.75%.**
